name: How long does it take to build an ADU?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to build an ADU?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for building an ADU can vary. The design and permitting phase often takes 3 to 6 months, depending on the complexity of the design and the responsiveness of local planning departments. Construction typically ranges from 4 to 9 months, influenced by the ADU's size, type, site conditions, and material availability. Overall, expect a total project duration of 7 to 15 months from start to finish.
acceptedAnswer.description: Building an ADU typically takes 7 to 15 months, with 3-6 months for design and permitting, and 4-9 months for construction.
